newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIU SAYS INVEKS ITS LATVIAN SECURITIES BASE.
newsitem.headline: HOIU SAYS INVEKS ITS LATVIAN SECURITIES BASE.

text.p: Hoiupank said on Monday it will use the Latvian brokerage company Inveks for its securities activities and analysis in the Latvian market.
Hoiu earlier announced it was buying Inveks and that the broker would soon apply for membership of the stock exchange.

"We plan to channel the whole of Hoiupank's security business through Inveks and start analysis (of Latvian companies) on the spot," Heino Viik, the head of Hoiupank's markets department, told Reuters.
Viik would not say how much Hoiu paid for its 76 percent stake in Inveks nor give any profit or turnover forecasts.
Hoiupank's strategy includes an expansion of its securities activities into Lithuania, Viik added.
"The plans exist but there are no concrete negotiations," he said.
